records.translation: Itlog ng Kawalan

records.source: A jet-black egg with red flecks. It's warm to the touch.
records.translation: Ubod-itim na itlog na may pulang mga batik. Mainit ito sa paghipo.
Esensiya ng Kawalan
Nanginginig ito sa madilim na enerhiya.
Palawit ng Multo ng Kawalan

records.source: It's symbolic to the shadow people. As a gift, it signifies the desire to move in together as friends.
records.translation: Makahulugan ito sa Mga Taong-Anino. Bilang regalo, ipinahihiwatig nito ang pagnanais na magsamang tumira bilang magkaibigan.
Mayonesa ng Kawalan

records.source: A thick, black paste that smells like burnt hair.
records.translation: Malapot at itim na pastang amoy sunog na buhok.
Salmon ng Kawalan
records.englishResidueReason: Salmon is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this fish species.

records.source: A salmon, twisted by void energy. The fresh meat is jet black, but rapidly turns pink when exposed to air.
records.translation: Salmon na binago ng enerhiya ng Kawalan. Ubod-itim ang sariwang laman ngunit mabilis na nagiging rosas kapag nalantad sa hangin.
records.englishResidueReason: Salmon is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this fish species.

records.translation: Batong Ginto

records.source: Break apart to obtain gold ore.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng mineral na ginto.

records.preserveReason: Walleye is the conventional borrowed Filipino name used consistently in existing fish-program text.

records.source: A freshwater fish caught at night.
records.translation: Isdang tubig-tabang na nahuhuli sa gabi.
Gunita ng Digmaan

records.source: It's a faded photograph of a soldier...
records.translation: Kupas na larawan ito ng isang sundalo...
Totem ng Paglipat: Dalampasigan

records.source: Warp directly to the beach. Consumed on use.
records.translation: Lumipat agad sa Dalampasigan. Nauubos kapag ginamit.
Totem ng Paglipat: Disyerto

records.source: Warp directly to Calico Desert. Consumed on use.
records.translation: Lumipat agad sa Disyerto ng Calico. Nauubos kapag ginamit.
Totem ng Paglipat: Bukid

records.source: Warp directly to your house. Consumed on use.
records.translation: Lumipat agad sa iyong bahay. Nauubos kapag ginamit.
Totem ng Paglipat: Isla

records.source: Warp directly to Ginger Island. Consumed on use.
records.translation: Lumipat agad sa Isla ng Luya. Nauubos kapag ginamit.
Totem ng Paglipat: Kabundukan

records.source: Warp directly to the mountains. Consumed on use.
records.translation: Lumipat agad sa kabundukan. Nauubos kapag ginamit.
Totem ng Paglipat: Arena ni Qi

records.source: Warp to Qi's Arena. Be prepared for a challenge!.
records.translation: Lumipat sa Arena ni Qi. Maghanda sa isang hamon!
Singsing ng Mandirigma

records.source: Occasionally infuses the wearer with "warrior energy" after slaying a monster.
records.translation: Paminsan-minsang binibigyan ang nagsusuot ng "enerhiya ng mandirigma" matapos pumatay ng halimaw.
Lipas na Sahig

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.
Singsing sa Kasal

records.source: An old Zuzu City tradition... It's used to ask for another farmer's hand in marriage.
records.translation: Lumang tradisyon sa Lungsod ng Zuzu... Ginagamit ito upang hingin ang kamay ng isa pang magsasaka sa pag-aasawa.
Mga Damo
Isang kumpol ng nakakainis na mga damo.
Mga Damo

records.source: A cluster of dry old bushes. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
records.translation: Kumpol ng tuyo at matatandang palumpong. Maaaring may lamang hibla o Halo-halong Binhi.
Mga Damo

records.source: Ugly weeds. Cut to obtain wild seeds.
records.translation: Mga pangit na damo. Putulin upang makakuha ng Mga Ligaw na Binhi.
